title: TelemetryEventsRow
description: One change or platform event (deploy, config, flag, scale, restart, k8s event, commit) over the full available span, overlay events included (03 §2.5). Written by Infralume; the key is not unique.

t_ns.description: Event time in ns since the Unix epoch (UTC), source time as given.

entity.description: Normalised service or component the event applies to.

source_system.description: System the event came from; every overlay (RCAEval-C) row is synthetic.

detail_json.description: Canonical JSON object, scrubbed, e.g. {"from":"...","image":"...","to":"..."}. Flag events (kind = flag) carry {"flag":<8-hex digest of the flag key>,"from":...,"to":...} (shape to be confirmed by Observe and Explain; not enforced here).

actor.description: Who made the change; null when unknown and for every overlay row.
